description: Start a durable child agent with exactly one origin: a named profile for a fresh child, or fork=true for completed parent context. Inspect or continue an associated child by agent_id; continue sends a new task only after its prior turn stops running. Set background=true on start or continue to return after process start, without waiting for the answer. Inspection reports process activity and durable transcript progress separately. Active means a parent admission slot; settled means a final transcript outcome after the process stopped. Add this tool to a profile's tools list to opt in.
